problem: Opaque GitHub API failures make trusted automation difficult to diagnose, while raw exception output can expose authentication material.
invariant: Trusted GitHub automation should report method, sanitized endpoint, HTTP status and bounded structured response details while removing authentication material. Unstructured failures should fall back to a generic diagnostic.
evidence: YACS test_proof_broker.py covers structured sanitization and opaque-error fallback
do_not_copy: product-specific error wording not required by the invariant
failure_behavior: If a failure cannot be rendered safely, return a generic BLOCKED diagnostic instead of raw exception text.
